## Root goal

<!-- State the actual desired end state. Do not substitute a narrower/easier task. -->

## Source of truth

<!-- Cite at least one concrete repository file, issue/PR, URL, or revision read before changing anything. -->

## Executed actions

<!-- Describe actual GitHub mutations: created/updated files, commits, branch, workflow, issue, or PR. Plans/explanations do not count. -->

## Read-back evidence

<!-- Must contain PASS only after re-reading the changed state. Cite the current PR head SHA so stale evidence cannot survive later code changes. -->

## Tests

<!-- Must contain PASS only after relevant tests actually ran successfully. Cite the workflow run/id or exact executed command. FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT RUN must not be converted into PASS by explanation. -->

## Cross-checks

<!-- Must contain PASS only after an independent reviewer/verifier is complete where available. Identify the reviewer/verifier. Self-review alone is not independent evidence. -->

## Remaining gaps

<!-- Must be exactly "None" before final acceptance. Otherwise leave the PR non-passing. -->

## Final status

<!-- Must be exactly PASS only when every acceptance criterion has observable evidence. -->

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Root goal preserved without scope reduction
- [ ] Source-of-truth includes a concrete file/issue/URL/revision reference
- [ ] PR contains observable commits and changed files
- [ ] Changed state read back against the current PR head SHA
- [ ] Relevant tests actually executed with run/id or command evidence
- [ ] Independent reviewer/verifier completed
- [ ] No completion claim relies only on documentation, policy, plausibility, or explanation
- [ ] Remaining gaps are None
- [ ] Final status is PASS
